Title

Senior at Penn State pursuing a Bachelor's in Enterprise Technology Integration with a minor in Data Science. Front-end web development through back-end data programming — with a soft spot for Web3 and blockchain.

Looking for an entry-level role where I can apply what I've built in school and ship real product with a team that moves.

I started tinkering with the web because I wanted things that looked and felt intentional — not just pages that worked.

Penn State sharpened that into systems thinking: how front-end craft, data, and infrastructure fit together. Side projects and org work (like Penn State IFC) taught me to ship under real constraints — deadlines, stakeholders, and users who don't care how clever the CSS is.

Now I'm focused on building polished interfaces and reliable backends, and finding a team where curiosity and craft still matter.
